ePWM Module Time Base Clock (TBCLK) Sync: Allows the user to globally synchronize all enabled ePWM modules to the time base clock (TBCLK): The TBCLK (Time Base Clock) within each enabled ePWM module is stopped. (default). If, however, the ePWM clock enable bit is set in the PCLKCR1 register, then the ePWM module will still be clocked by SYSCLKOUT even if TBCLKSYNC is 0. All enabled ePWM module clocks are started with the first rising edge of TBCLK aligned. For perfectly synchronized TBCLKs, the prescaler bits in the TBCTL register of each ePWM module must be set identically. The proper procedure for enabling ePWM clocks is as follows: • Enable ePWM module clocks in the PCLKCR1 register. • Set TBCLKSYNC to 0. • Configure prescaler values and ePWM modes. • Set TBCLKSYNC to 1.
